- Discuss model variant and quantization trade-offs for cost vs. latency
- Plan staging/validation and rollout steps (auth, access, audit logs)

- Thu, Jun 17 — 9:00-10:15 AM

I'll bring our ML infra leads (Dylan Brooks) and our solution engineer (Camila Reyes). If you confirm a time, I will send a calendar invite and a short draft agenda + checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Subject: RE: Post-discovery: schedule technical deep dive (ML/infra, 60-90 min)

Hi all — thanks for scheduling. A few items I'd like to include on the deep-dive agenda so we can make the 75 minutes as productive as possible:

1) Data & preprocessing (10 min)
- sample file shapes, typical sequence length distribution, tokenization examples
- redacted sample (please upload a small slice ahead of time)

2) Inference requirements (20 min)
- p50/p95/p99 latency targets and throughput (requests/sec, concurrency)
- target batch sizes and max sequence lengths

3) Model selection & quantization (15 min)
- trade-offs (INT8/4-bit) and compatibility with your accuracy targets
- fallback/variant strategy (smaller/faster vs. larger/higher quality)

4) Integration & access (15 min)
- auth patterns (service account, temporary tokens), S3 access, VPC considerations
- logging, audit trails, and data retention expectations

5) Next steps / rollout plan (10 min)
- staging test matrix, SLAs, runbook owners

If you can pre-share a redacted CSV and an infra diagram (PNG/PDF) that would let us prepare a short perf checklist. I've attached a one-page inference_checklist.md to the calendar folder for reference.

Looking forward to it — see you Fri.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Principal ML Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
